# Object Digital Passport

**Open standard for verifiable object authenticity** — a readable on-chain card, cryptographic hashes, append-only history, public registry. No platform lock-in. Free to verify, forever.

**Live demo:** [**object-digital-passport.github.io/object-digital-passport**](https://object-digital-passport.github.io/object-digital-passport/) · [Verify](https://object-digital-passport.github.io/object-digital-passport/verify.html) (no wallet) · [Profile](https://object-digital-passport.github.io/object-digital-passport/creator.html) · [Passport](https://object-digital-passport.github.io/object-digital-passport/passport.html)

> 🙋 **We're looking for people** — developers, testers, designers, translators, artists, skeptics. The project is built openly with AI-assisted development ("vibecoding") steered by product vision — experienced eyes on every layer are welcome. Start in [**Discussions**](https://github.com/object-digital-passport/object-digital-passport/discussions).
